load_data: load a pickle file containing hand predictions and object point cloud data
interpolate_pointclouds: interpolate an array of point clouds along the first dimension to get a target number of frames
trajectory_from_grasp: build a grasp trajectory with interpolated hand and object point clouds from prediction data
add_ground: add a flat ground plane mesh to a rerun 3D visualization scene
visualize: visualize hand mesh, landmarks, and object point clouds as an animated trajectory in rerun
